statement.provision: Agreement particulars (p1); App A Commencement Date (p34)
Cl.8 (p3); App A Rest day (p34); p1 particulars

statement.title: The record identifies what the line claims - work area, date (a weekly record lists each day worked), item and quantity; the line is compared with it
validation: weekly record whose week crosses a month boundary: each day worked is still identified (47A)
record date differs from line date: a mismatch fact, kept separate from reuse and duplication (Q7)
record wording differs from the Bill of Quantities description: not a mismatch by itself (Sch 5 note)

statement.title: Measured quantity - record quantity; hourly items one hour fewer; weekly items need >= 5 days; survey tolerance 2%
validation: billed above the record: payable up to the record (guideline check 5)
billed below the record: payable as billed, never raised to the record (underbilling is Q10)

statement.title: Line identified against the correct item; trench depth decides A.12.020/030/040; unresolvable identification stays unresolved
validation: trench spanning two depth bands measured in parts
two candidate items -> unresolved, never cheapest

statement.title: Codes outside Sch 1 (daywork, provisional and prime cost sums, preliminaries, unrated work) are valued only by their own route and its conditions; a condition the supplied data cannot evidence leaves the line an unresolved query, never priced by default
validation: daywork line: Sch 6 rates plus Part 3 additions only with a daywork sheet signed on the day (Cl.17); none supplied -> query
provisional sum line: only on the Engineer's written instruction (Cl.16); none supplied (Q8) -> query
synthetic PR.01 line: a fixed item 486,000.00 valued once when the obligation is discharged (Sch 8); discharge not evidenced -> query

statement.title: Outcome recorded per application - pass, query or part-reject, with the clause relied on, the figure payable, and anything that could not be determined
validation: unpriceable application stays a query; what is missing is recorded rather than a guessed figure (guideline principle 3); the unknown-total encoding is Q9
